title: Top hat
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="hatBody" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#4a3a6a"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#6b4fa8"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="brim" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#7a5fc0"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#5a4090"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="band" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff6b9d"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#e0457a"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="shine" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#9b7fd4"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#c4a8f0"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  
  <!-- Hat brim -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="34" ry="9" fill="url(#brim)"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="71" rx="34" ry="8.5" fill="url(#brim)"/>
  
  <!-- Brim highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="70" rx="30" ry="6.5" fill="#8b6fd0" opacity="0.5"/>
  
  <!-- Hat body -->
  <path d="M 28 72 L 30 30 Q 30 22 38 22 L 62 22 Q 70 22 70 30 L 72 72 Z" fill="url(#hatBody)"/>
  
  <!-- Hat body highlight -->
  <path d="M 34 72 L 35 30 Q 35 26 40 25 L 46 25 L 44 72 Z" fill="url(#shine)" opacity="0.4"/>
  
  <!-- Hat band -->
  <path d="M 28.5 62 L 29 52 L 71 52 L 71.5 62 Z" fill="url(#band)"/>
  
  <!-- Band shine -->
  <path d="M 32 62 L 32.5 52 L 40 52 L 39.5 62 Z" fill="#ff9dc0" opacity="0.5"/>
  
  <!-- Hat top -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="30" rx="20" ry="8" fill="#5a4a8a"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="29" rx="19" ry="7" fill="#6b55a5" opacity="0.6"/>
  
  <!-- Top highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="46" cy="28" rx="8" ry="3.5" fill="#a890e0" opacity="0.4"/>
  
  <!-- Cute sparkles -->
  <circle cx="24" cy="48" r="2" fill="#ffdd44" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="52" r="1.8" fill="#ffdd44" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="60" r="1.3" fill="#ffdd44" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="76" cy="40" r="1.5" fill="#ffdd44" opacity="0.6"/>
  
  <!-- Small star -->
  <path d="M 22 38 L 23 36 L 24 38 L 26 39 L 24 40 L 23 42 L 22 40 L 20 39 Z" fill="#ffe066" opacity="0.8"/>
</svg>
